title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.28680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. translated_title: 改进改进者：面向医疗智能体自我改进的语义PID控制
translated_abstract: 高风险的垂直医疗任务，如术后病理分期和长期生存预测，需要在弱监督和高结果不确定性的条件下，对异质性证据进行多步骤临床推理。我们首先构建了CliAgent，一个领域定制的临床智能体工作流，能够系统地将预测建立在多模态患者证据之上。然而，手动设计的医疗智能体仍然受限于静态、脆弱的规则。此外，现有的递归自我改进（RSI）方法在高噪声医疗领域中演化智能体时，存在反馈歧义和严重的开发集过拟合问题。着眼于改进改进者本身，我们提出了Semantic PID-RSI，一个证据引导的、基于控制论的医疗智能体自我改进框架。受PID控制启发，我们的改进器通过三个诊断角色评估候选修改批次：P隔离当前的临床失败模式，I综合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Semantic PID-RSI框架，借鉴PID控制理论，通过证据引导的三个诊断角色来改进医疗智能体的自我改进过程本身，解决了现有递归自我改进方法在高噪声医疗领域中的反馈歧义与开发集过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework inspired by PID control that improves the improver for medical agent self-improvement, addressing feedback ambiguity and development-set overfitting in high-noise medical domains.
